sources.snippet: Bird Classifier EfficientNet-B2 Model Description Have you look at a bird and said "Boahh if only I know what bird that is". Unless you're an avid bird spotter (or just love birds in general), it's hard to differentiate some species of birds. Well you're in luck, turns out you can use a image classifier to identify bird species! This model is a fine-tuned version of google/efficientnet-b2 on ...
